releases.summary: Fieldbook 4.1 brings repeating sections to checklists, so one checklist covers every floor or unit of a site, and makes the web app's inspection list much faster.

changes.title: Repeating sections
changes.detail: Mark a section as repeating and inspectors add a copy for each floor, unit or room they inspect. Reports number the copies.

changes.title: Saved filters on the inspection list
changes.detail: Save a filter, such as overdue inspections at one site, and open it again from the sidebar.

changes.title: The inspection list opens four times faster
changes.detail: Workspaces with more than 20,000 inspections see the biggest change.

changes.title: The camera no longer opens twice on some tablets
Version 1 of the export API
changes.detail: Version 1 keeps working until 30 June 2027. Move integrations to version 2, which returns the same data with repeating sections.

releases.summary: Fieldbook 4.2 adds sign-off on behalf of a site contact, scheduled inspections and a darker map style for working outdoors, and fixes two sync problems reported after 4.1.2.
releases.upgradeNote: Phones must run Fieldbook 4.1 or later to sync with a workspace on 4.2. Ask inspectors to update before 30 November 2026.

changes.title: Sign off on behalf of a site contact
changes.detail: When the site contact can't sign on screen, an inspector can record a verbal sign-off with the contact's name and the time. Reports show it as a verbal sign-off.

changes.title: Scheduled inspections
changes.detail: Plan an inspection for a date and inspector; it appears in their app the day before, with its checklist ready offline.

changes.title: High-contrast map style
changes.detail: A darker map that stays readable in bright sunlight. Turn it on under Settings, Display.

changes.title: Photos upload in the background
changes.detail: Inspectors can start the next inspection while photos from the last one finish uploading.

changes.title: Shorter PDF reports
changes.detail: Checks with no findings collapse to one line each, so a typical report is a third shorter.

changes.title: Edits made offline on two devices no longer overwrite each other
changes.detail: Fieldbook now keeps both answers and asks which one to keep.

changes.title: Sync no longer stops when the app is in the background for more than ten minutes
Sessions end after 12 hours without activity
changes.detail: Administrators can shorten this under Workspace settings, Security.

changes.title: The classic report layout
changes.detail: The classic layout will be removed in Fieldbook 5.0. Reports that use it show a notice with a link to switch.

releases.summary: A maintenance release for the phone apps.

changes.title: Repeating sections keep their photos after a copy is deleted
Signatures are no longer cut off on smaller phones
Updated the image library to fix a flaw in reading crafted photo files

knownIssues.title: Scheduled inspections show in UTC on the web calendar
knownIssues.detail: The web app's calendar shows the scheduled time in UTC instead of the workspace's time zone. The phone apps show the right time.
knownIssues.workaround: Check the time in the phone app, or on the inspection's own page in the web app.

knownIssues.title: Verbal sign-offs are missing from CSV exports
knownIssues.detail: Reports show verbal sign-offs, but the CSV export leaves the sign-off columns empty for them.
knownIssues.workaround: Use the PDF report, or the export API version 2, which includes them.
